article.title: Friendbuy推出創作者管理工具，串連推薦、會員與後續購買資料
article.title_en: Friendbuy launches influencer software linking creator acquisition with repeat purchases
article.summary: Friendbuy於11月3日宣布Influencer正式提供，品牌可自行管理創作者及聯盟計劃。
article.summary_en: Friendbuy announced general availability of Influencer on November 3 for brand-managed creator and affiliate programs.
highlights: 管理邀請、活動、佣金及付款，並非創作者交易市場。
結合Referral與Loyalty後，可追蹤重複購買及推薦行為。
highlights_en: It manages invitations, campaigns, commissions and payouts rather than operating a marketplace.
With Referral and Loyalty, brands can follow repeat orders and referrals.
article.why: 品牌可把創作者帶來的首單與客戶後續行為連起來，減少只看一次轉換的盲點。
article.why_en: Brands can connect first creator-driven orders with later customer activity.
article.next_step: 先統一佣金歸因窗口、退貨處理及客戶資料欄位，再評估整合。
article.next_step_en: Align attribution windows, returns and customer fields before evaluating integration.
article.detail: 按公告與官方產品頁，品牌自行招募創作者，設定活動及分級佣金，透過Tremendous處理付款；工具可單獨使用，也可接入既有推薦及會員計劃。官方FAQ指佣金歸因受點擊後的設定窗口及購買驗證影響，因此資料連接不等於證明新增生意。網站刊出的Bathhouse推薦計劃數字，亦不代表新Influencer工具已產生相同結果。本報未引用該等成效。
article.detail_en: Brands recruit creators and configure tiered commissions, with payouts through Tremendous. It works alone or with Referral and Loyalty. Attribution depends on configured windows and purchase validation. Bathhouse referral-program results are not evidence of the new influencer product’s impact.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
